turns.answer:
The very first thing that happened was your text being broken down into chunks of data called "tokens"—essentially converting your words into a sequence of numbers. 

Because I am an AI, I don't "read" in a human sense. I don't look at the first word, process it, and move on to the next. Instead, my system received your entire message simultaneously as a mathematical input and instantly began computing this response.
